detaileddescription.para: HighMap is a C++ library for procedural generation, simulation, and analysis of 2D heightmaps and terrain assets.
A heightmap is a two-dimensional grid of elevation values. Each cell corresponds to a spatial position, with values typically normalized to $[0, 1]$ or expressed in world elevation units.

listitem.para: Quickstart: Minimal working example, CMake integration, and common operations.
Core Concepts: Elevation data structures (Array, HeightMap, VirtualArray), bivariate functions, vector primitives, and entity scattering.
